from.description: Rounds added to Fundable on or after this day: the last run's `unread_from` when it has one, else the last run's `to`, else today minus the lookback.

window.description: The days read, by the day Fundable added the round.

quiet.description: True only when the deals search ran and found no round that was not already reported. A search that failed, or a sector that matched no Fundable industry, makes it false.

sectors.description: Each sector or keyword the owner gave and the Fundable industry it was matched to.

permalink.description: The permalink `industry/search` answered with; null when nothing matched.

rounds.description: The new rounds this run read, largest first, at most `max_rounds`.

company.description: The raising company as the round's description names it.

what_it_does.description: From the round's description, or Crunchbase's short description when it was read.

stage.description: The round type as a person says it: Pre-seed, Seed, Series A, Series B extension.

lead.description: Who led, as the description names them. Empty when it names no lead.

links.description: The round's articles as Fundable gives them, the primary one first.

matched_total.description: How many rounds the deals search matched (its `total_count`), so the reader sees what the cap left out. Null when it did not run.

reported_deal_ids.description: The ids of every round reported this run, so the next run skips them.

unread_from.description: The first day whose rounds this run could not read: `window.from` when the deals search or a sector's industry search failed, so the next run starts there and reads those days again. Null when every sector was searched and the deals search answered. A sector that matches no Fundable industry is not a failure.
